conditional_findings.classification: New conditional current source question: field dimensions subtract and increment signed cell coordinates before widening.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: If a plan with a sufficiently wide cell span reaches InteriorField::from_plan, i16 arithmetic can overflow before the resulting width is cast to u32.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: BuildingPlan room-cell aggregate admission and interior field dimension calculation.
conditional_findings.trace: Cell coordinates are public i16 values. The field finds min_x across room cells and evaluates c.x - min_x + 1 in that type before the as u32 cast. A hypothetical plan containing cells with x=0 and x=32767 causes the final +1 to exceed i16::MAX under checked arithmetic. Native field construction then also multiplies width, depth and levels as u32 before allocating samples.
conditional_findings.safeguards: This is source arithmetic, not a constructed, generated, deserialized or executed plan. The normal footprint_cells helper rejects widths above i16::MAX and generates x from zero strictly below width, so it does not itself emit x=32767; all plan generators and transformations, callers, validation and supported input policy remain untraced. An earlier producer may reject or fail first. No product run, panic, allocation or accepted witness observed.
dependencies: Trace every supported BuildingPlan producer and its room-cell extent and uniqueness admission before assessing reachability.
Establish the field storage and GPU capacity policy together with index and allocation bounds.
acceptance_requirements: Every supported room-cell aggregate yields checked field dimensions, indices and resource use, with errors attributed to the source plan.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; symbolic checked-arithmetic case and one generator safeguard, actual supported aggregate and aliases open

conditional_findings.classification: New conditional current source question: exposure and GPU daylight use different field selections.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: A camera can derive indoor exposure from a field omitted from the GPU daylight set if the supported camera/building population can exceed that set.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Active-camera field selection, CPU exposure and GPU field residency policy.
conditional_findings.trace: compensation_at samples every InteriorField query without the upload selection. upload_field collects active camera positions, ranks fields by minimum distance and entity, truncates to16 buildings, then retains only those fitting its65,536-sample budget. The shader traverses only uploaded buildings and returns zero interior sample when none contains the surface. If an active gameplay camera is inside a nonresident field and no selected field contains its surface, CPU compensation can reflect that room while the shader follows its exterior PBR branch.
conditional_findings.safeguards: No multi-camera scene, over-capacity eligible field, valid geometry, ordering, material, shader output or image has been observed. The cap is explicit and may be an intentional supported-mode boundary. Camera population, entity ties, per-scene isolation, authored building density, exposure scheduling and selected-surface policy remain open.
dependencies: Trace actual active camera configurations, field population, maximum field size and selection across supported scenes.
Resolve whether exposure must use the same resident field, or whether capacity and fallback are defined as a supported quality policy.
acceptance_requirements: Supported camera exposure and daylight selection share an explicit coherent field/residency or documented fallback contract, including capacity limits.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; independent source selection paths and conditional capacity case, supported mode and observable effect open
